name: walk_drink
text: A person walks continuously forward carrying a drink cup in the right hand at chest height, raises the cup to the lips for one sip, then lowers it back to chest height while continuing to walk. The left arm swings naturally.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 四个步态周期内抬杯喝一次再放回胸前，正侧面确认抬杯到嘴前并持续前行；保留第二段完整循环，首尾同姿势。杯子后续挂到右手。
review.review_frame_convention: review.png uses final delivered clip frame indices, beginning at 0.
